question: Does the existing trained planner preserve a supported brief across new synthetic topology instances, wording changes and geometry perturbations, compared with its matched base?
intendedDecision: Identify remaining failure mechanisms and whether a larger field-oriented confirmation is justified; no automatic promotion.
scope: Controlled synthetic stress evaluation; solver-selected positive tasks; not natural task prevalence or creator benefit.
stopRule: No paid-request retries. Complete the second arm of each pair unless budget stops. Stop after two consecutive pairs with neither outcome available; preserve every remaining scheduled occurrence as unattempted. Never retry this frozen execution under a new directory.

analysis.primary: Paired difference in brief-preserving plan rate on known-positive tasks, per occurrence, with whole-scene-group bootstrap retaining conditions and repeats.
secondary: Correct checked abstention on explicit unsupported tasks, kept separate from productive plans
Wording consistency within scene and trial
Invalid returned plans, schema errors, repairs
Parent monotonic and wall elapsed time; child event-loop delay; complete and unknown token usage
analysis.missingness: Unavailable outcomes have no quality grade. Scheduled operational delivery and paired-available quality are separate. Intervals do not correct missingness.

privacy: Authored geometry and model actions only; no creator footage or credentials. Publication uses scored metadata to the existing private Forge project.
limitations: Two repetitions do not establish generation stability.
Twelve authored groups are not a population of real rooms.
Geometry/checker share the product engine; independent physical validity is unproven.
Parent watchdog cannot defeat host suspension and does not cancel provider computation.
Model artifact lineage is verified from recorded service metadata, not weight-byte access.
This test does not isolate which training example category caused a difference.
